feed_title: Waterproof Nest Dog Bed, High Sided, Coated Wipe Clean Outer, Removable Cover, Medium 65 x 45cm to XL 90 x 70cm | PawLunova Crummock
descriptionHtml:
High sides. Coated wipe-clean outer. For the dog who curls up muddy.

Crummock is a waterproof high-sided nest dog bed with a coated wipe-clean outer and a cushioned base, in Medium 65 × 45cm, Large 70 × 55cm and XL 90 × 70cm.

A wet walk ends the same way every time. They come in through the back door, shake once in the hall, and head straight for the softest thing in the room. By the time the lead is hung up they are already curled into it, and half a field has gone in with them.

The walls here stay high, and the surface stretched over them is coated rather than woven soft. Mud and drool sit on top of it instead of soaking down into the fill.

What they get

  • Walls on all four sides: Something to press a spine and a chin against, which is how a curler actually settles.
  • A coated outer fabric: Wet paw prints stay on the surface. A damp cloth takes them off.
  • A cushioned base underneath: Soft fill rather than a firm foam slab, so this is a nest and not a mattress.
  • A zipped cover that lifts off: For the deeper clean a cloth cannot manage.
  • Three sizes, 65 × 45cm to 90 × 70cm: Measured on the outside, walls included.

Best for: dogs who sleep jammed into a corner, houses with a wet dog and a pale carpet, and older dogs who have started having the odd accident.

Why it is worth the money

The Medium is £99, the Large £119 and the XL £139. What that buys back is wash cycles. A fleece nest after a wet Sunday is a machine load and a day drying over a radiator. This one is a cloth and about thirty seconds.

And you are not gambling the money. If they have not claimed it within 100 nights, we collect it free from the UK mainland and refund you in full.

One thing to be straight about. A coated fabric does not feel like fleece under your hand and it never will. That is the trade you are making for a skin you can wipe.

Size and fit

SizeOutside (cm)What to know
Medium65 × 45Smallest footprint, walls included
Large70 × 5510cm wider than the Medium
XL90 × 70The most room inside the walls

These are outside measurements and the high sides take up a fair part of them. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm, then picture that shape curled rather than stretched, because curling is what this one is for. Size up if you land between two. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one fits.

Everyday care

Wipe the coated outer for everyday marks. Check the sewn-in label before you wash the removable cover, because detergent and machine washing can affect some waterproof finishes. Air-dry fully before refitting.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.
